pages_show_list.text: Siar (app.siaran.my) is a dashboard where a business publishes to and manages its own social media accounts. When a business clicks Social accounts → Connect Facebook and completes Facebook Login for Business, Siar uses pages_show_list to list the Facebook Pages that person manages, so they can choose the Page Siar publishes to (Change → the Page list, and Refresh list to fetch it again). The chosen Page's name is shown on the account card. Without this permission the person cannot pick a Page and Siar cannot publish or manage anything on Facebook. The list is shown only to the person connecting, inside their own Siar team. The screencast shows the consent screen ("Show a list of the Pages you manage"), the Page list in Siar with FF Dev Studio, and FF Dev Studio set as the Page Siar publishes to.

business_management.text: Most of our customers' Pages and Instagram accounts are owned by a Meta Business portfolio. In Facebook Login for Business the person chooses the businesses and Pages to share with Siar; business_management lets Siar read the portfolio-owned Pages they selected so those Pages appear in Siar's Page list (and their linked Instagram accounts can be connected). Siar uses it only to list and access the assets the person selected. It does not read or change ads, billing, people or any other business settings. Without it, Pages owned by a business portfolio cannot be connected to Siar. The screencast shows the Businesses step of the login (the FF Dev Studio portfolio), the "Manage your business" line on the consent screen, and the portfolio's Page listed in Siar after Refresh list.

public_profile.text: When a person connects Facebook to Siar, Siar reads their name and Facebook user id (public_profile) to show who connected the account: the account card in Social accounts says "Signed in as Fakhrul Dev". A team uses this to see which person's login an account depends on and who needs to reconnect when Facebook asks for it. The name is shown only inside that team's Siar workspace and is not used for anything else. The screencast shows the login as Fakhrul Dev and the connected card reading "Signed in as Fakhrul Dev".

pages_manage_posts.text: Publishing is Siar's core feature. A business writes a post in Siar's composer (text, images, video, links), picks their Facebook Page, and publishes now or at a scheduled time; Siar uses pages_manage_posts to create that post on the Page. When the user deletes the post in Siar, the confirmation says it is deleted from Facebook too, and Siar deletes it from the Page with the same permission. Siar only publishes or deletes posts the user created and asked for. Without this permission Siar cannot publish to Facebook at all. The screencast shows the grant ("Create and manage content on your Page"), composing and publishing a post with an image to the FF Dev Studio Page, the live post on facebook.com, deleting it from Siar, and facebook.com showing the post is no longer available.

pages_read_engagement.text: After Siar publishes a post to a Page, the business wants to know how it is doing. Siar uses pages_read_engagement to read the Page's basic details (name, picture, link) and the likes, comments and views on the posts Siar published. These figures appear on each post in Siar (Posts → open a post → Facebook figures, with a Refresh button) and in Analytics. Without it Siar could only say that a post went out, not how people responded. The figures are shown only to that business's team. The screencast opens a published post, presses Refresh so Siar reads the latest likes and comments from Facebook (1 like, 2 comments, 8 views), then shows the same 1 like and 2 comments on facebook.com.

pages_read_user_content.text: Businesses use Siar's Inbox to read and answer comments from all their networks in one place. Siar uses pages_read_user_content to read the comments people leave on the Page's posts (the comment text, author, time and like count), so they appear in Inbox → Comments, and Import comments fetches the comments of a chosen published post. Without it the business would have to leave Siar to see what people are saying on their Page. Comments are shown only to the team of the business that owns the Page. The screencast shows Inbox → Import comments for the post "Siar comments test" on the FF Dev Studio Page, Siar reading the comment's text, time and its like, and the same comment by Jon Doe on facebook.com.

pages_manage_engagement.text: From Siar's Inbox a business moderates the comments on its Page's posts: it replies as the Page, likes a comment, hides or unhides it, and deletes it. Siar uses pages_manage_engagement for exactly these actions, and only when a team member clicks the button; it also posts a first comment the user scheduled with their own post. Without it the business would have to switch to Facebook for every reply and moderation step. The screencast shows each action on Jon Doe's comment on the FF Dev Studio Page: Reply (the Page's reply live on facebook.com), Like, Hide (hidden on facebook.com), Unhide (shown again), and Delete of the Page's reply and then of the comment, with facebook.com showing "No comments yet".

pages_manage_metadata.text: Siar subscribes the connected Page to Siar's app webhooks (the feed and messages fields) with pages_manage_metadata, so a new comment or message reaches the business's Siar Inbox within seconds instead of after polling. When the business turns messages off in Siar, Siar stops ingesting them and leaves other subscriptions on the Page intact. Without it the Inbox would only update on a slow polling schedule and miss conversations. The screencast keeps Siar's Inbox open while Jon Doe comments on the Page's post and then messages the Page from another account: each appears in Siar within seconds with no reload, and the same comment is shown on facebook.com.

read_insights.text: Siar's Analytics shows a business how its Facebook Page is performing so it can see what works. Siar uses read_insights to read the Page's insights (followers, impressions, views, likes and comments over time, and the same figures per post) and shows them as charts and a Top posts table in Analytics → Facebook, with a Refresh now button. Without it Siar could not show the business any Page performance. The metrics are shown only to the team of the business that owns the Page. The screencast shows the grant ("Access your Page and App insights"), then Analytics → Facebook → Refresh now, and the Page's followers, impressions, views, likes and comments by day and its top posts.

pages_messaging.text: Businesses answer their Messenger conversations in Siar's Inbox alongside Instagram DMs and comments. When the business turns on messages for its Page in Siar (Inbox → Messages → Turn on messages, which runs Facebook Login for Business with the messaging permission), messages people send to the Page appear in Siar and the business replies from Siar; Siar sends the reply with pages_messaging as a RESPONSE inside Messenger's 24-hour window. Siar never sends a message the business did not write and does not send promotional or automated broadcast messages. Without it the business could not handle Page conversations in Siar. The screencast shows turning messages on with the grant ("Manage and access Page conversations on Messenger"), Jon Doe messaging the Page, the message arriving in Siar, a reply typed and sent from Siar, and both messages in the Page's Messenger inbox in Meta Business Suite.

Business Asset User Profile Access.text: When someone messages a business's Page, Messenger's webhook only carries a numeric id. Siar uses Business Asset User Profile Access to look up that person's name and profile picture once, so the business sees who it is talking to in Siar's Inbox (the conversation list and the conversation header) instead of an anonymous id. The name and picture are shown only in the Inbox of the business the person contacted, are not used for anything else, and are not shared. Without it every conversation would show a bare id and the business could not tell customers apart. The screencast shows Jon Doe's message arriving in Siar with his name and profile picture, the open conversation with the same name and picture, and the reply sent to him.

instagram_basic.text: Businesses whose Instagram professional account is linked to a Facebook Page connect it to Siar with Facebook Login for Business. Siar uses instagram_basic to read the account's username, profile picture and media, so the person can see which account is connected ("Connected through Facebook: Instagram @ffdev.studio"), pick it in the composer, and so Siar can show the account's posts and link to them. Without it Siar cannot identify or use the Instagram account. The data is shown only to that business's team. The screencast shows the login, choosing @ffdev.studio in the Instagram accounts step, the "Access profile and posts from the selected Instagram account" line, and @ffdev.studio connected in Siar.

instagram_content_publish.text: Publishing to Instagram is a core Siar feature. A business writes a caption in Siar's composer, adds photos, a carousel or a Reel, chooses its Instagram account, and publishes now or at a scheduled time; Siar uses instagram_content_publish to create the media container and publish it to the account. Siar only publishes posts the user created and asked to publish. Without it the business cannot post to Instagram from Siar. The screencast shows the grant ("Upload media and create posts"), composing a post with an image for @ffdev.studio, Publish now, the Posted status, and View on Instagram opening the live post.

instagram_manage_insights.text: Siar's Analytics shows a business how its Instagram account and posts perform. For an account connected through a Facebook Page, Siar uses instagram_manage_insights to read the account's followers, impressions, views, likes and comments and the same figures per post, shown as charts and a Top posts table in Analytics → Instagram with a Refresh now button. Without it the business would see no Instagram performance in Siar. The metrics are shown only to that business's team. The screencast shows the grant ("Access insights for the Instagram account"), then Analytics → Instagram → Refresh now, the latest insights and the top posts.

instagram_manage_comments.text: Comments on a business's Instagram posts appear in Siar's Inbox next to its other networks, and the business moderates them there. For an account connected through a Facebook Page, Siar uses instagram_manage_comments to read the comments on the account's media and, when a team member clicks, to reply as the account, hide or unhide a comment, and delete it; it also posts a first comment the user scheduled with their own post. Without it the business would have to leave Siar to handle Instagram comments. The screencast shows fakhrlfahmi's comment on @ffdev.studio's post in Siar, a reply (live on instagram.com), Hide and Unhide (checked on instagram.com), and deleting the reply and the comment, with instagram.com showing "No comments yet".

instagram_manage_messages.text: Businesses answer Instagram DMs in Siar's Inbox alongside Messenger and comments. For an account connected through a Facebook Page, the business turns on Instagram messages in Siar (Inbox → Messages → Turn on messages, which runs Facebook Login for Business with the messaging permission). DMs people send to the account then appear in Siar, and the business replies from Siar inside the 24-hour window; Siar uses instagram_manage_messages to receive the messages and send the replies. Siar never sends a message the business did not write. Without it the business could not handle Instagram DMs in Siar. The screencast shows the grant ("Manage and access messages for the Instagram account"), fakhrlfahmi sending @ffdev.studio a DM, the DM in Siar, a reply sent from Siar, and the conversation on instagram.com showing the reply as Seen.

instagram_business_basic.text: Businesses with an Instagram professional account that has no Facebook Page connect it to Siar with Instagram Login. Siar uses instagram_business_basic to read the account's username, profile picture and media, so the person can see which account is connected ("Signed in as @ffdev.studio"), choose it in the composer, and link to its posts. Without it Siar cannot identify or use an Instagram account connected with Instagram Login. The data is shown only to that business's team. The screencast shows Connect Instagram → Instagram Login, the consent screen line "View profile and access media", and @ffdev.studio connected in Siar.

instagram_business_content_publish.text: For an Instagram professional account connected with Instagram Login, Siar uses instagram_business_content_publish to publish the photos, carousels and Reels a business creates in Siar's composer, now or at a scheduled time. Siar only publishes posts the user created and asked to publish. Without it the business cannot post to an Instagram account connected this way. The screencast shows the grant ("Access and publish content"), composing a post with an image for @ffdev.studio, Publish now, the Posted status, and View on Instagram opening the live post.

instagram_business_manage_insights.text: For an Instagram professional account connected with Instagram Login, Siar uses instagram_business_manage_insights to read the account's followers, impressions, views, likes and comments and the same figures per post, shown in Analytics → Instagram as charts by day and a Top posts table, with a Refresh now button. Without it the business would see no performance figures for that account in Siar. The metrics are shown only to that business's team. The screencast shows the grant ("Access and manage insights"), then Analytics → Instagram → Refresh now and the resulting insights and top posts.

instagram_business_manage_comments.text: For an Instagram professional account connected with Instagram Login, Siar uses instagram_business_manage_comments to read the comments on the account's posts into Siar's Inbox and, when a team member clicks, to reply as the account, hide or unhide a comment, and delete it; it also posts a first comment the user scheduled with their own post. Without it the business would have to leave Siar to handle comments on that account. The screencast shows fakhrlfahmi's comment on @ffdev.studio's post in Siar, a reply (live on instagram.com), Hide and Unhide (checked on instagram.com), and deleting the reply and then the comment, with instagram.com showing "No comments yet".

instagram_business_manage_messages.text: For an Instagram professional account connected with Instagram Login, the business turns on messages in Siar (Inbox → Messages → Turn on messages, which opens Instagram's consent screen with the messaging permission). DMs people send to the account then appear in Siar's Inbox and the business replies from Siar inside the 24-hour window; Siar uses instagram_business_manage_messages to receive the messages and send those replies. Siar never sends a message the business did not write. Without it the business could not handle that account's DMs in Siar. The screencast shows the grant ("Access and manage messages"), fakhrlfahmi sending @ffdev.studio a DM, the DM in Siar, a reply sent from Siar, and the conversation on instagram.com showing the reply as Seen.

threads_basic.text: Businesses connect their Threads profile to Siar to publish and manage it with their other networks. Siar uses threads_basic to read the connected profile's username, name and picture, so the person sees which profile is connected ("Signed in as @ffdev.studio"), can choose it in the composer, and so Siar can link to its posts. Without it Siar cannot identify or use the Threads profile. The data is shown only to that business's team. The screencast shows Connect Threads, the consent line "Access and display your Threads information", and @ffdev.studio connected in Siar.

threads_content_publish.text: A business writes a post in Siar's composer (text, images, video or a carousel), chooses its Threads profile, and publishes now or at a scheduled time; Siar uses threads_content_publish to publish it to the profile. Siar only publishes posts the user created and asked to publish. Without it the business cannot post to Threads from Siar. The screencast shows the grant ("Create and share posts"), composing a post for @ffdev.studio, Publish now, the Posted status, View on Threads, and the live post on threads.com.

threads_manage_insights.text: Siar's Analytics shows a business how its Threads profile performs. Siar uses threads_manage_insights to read the profile's followers and its posts' views, likes and replies, shown in Analytics → Threads with a Refresh now button and a Top posts table. Without it the business would see no Threads performance in Siar. The metrics are shown only to that business's team. The screencast shows the grant ("Manage insights of posts"), then Analytics → Threads → Refresh now, the latest insights and the top posts with their views, likes and replies.

threads_delete.text: When a business deletes a Threads post in Siar, the confirmation says it is deleted from Threads too, and Siar uses threads_delete to remove the post from the profile, so a post the business no longer wants is gone everywhere at once. Siar deletes only posts it published for that business, and only when a team member confirms. Without it a post deleted in Siar would stay live on Threads. The screencast shows the grant ("Delete Threads posts"), opening the published post in Siar, Delete with the "It is deleted from Threads too" confirmation, "Post deleted" in Siar, and the profile on threads.com no longer showing the post.

threads_read_replies.text: Replies people leave on a business's Threads posts appear in Siar's Inbox next to comments from the business's other networks. Siar uses threads_read_replies to read the replies to the profile's posts (the reply text, author and time) when the business imports them (Inbox → Import comments → choose a Threads post). Without it the business would have to leave Siar to see replies on Threads. Replies are shown only to that business's team. The screencast shows Import comments for the post "Siar Threads replies test" on @ffdev.studio, and fakhrlfahmi's reply read into Siar's Inbox.

threads_manage_replies.text: From Siar's Inbox a business answers and moderates replies on its Threads posts. Siar uses threads_manage_replies to post the business's answer under a reply and to hide or unhide a reply, only when a team member clicks. Without it the business would have to switch to Threads for every answer and moderation step. The screencast shows a reply to fakhrlfahmi sent from Siar (shown on threads.com), Hide on fakhrlfahmi's reply (Hidden in Siar), and threads.com's "Hidden by you" list containing it.
